name: PART 001 - F1 front wing mounting bracket

leg_base_length.name: leg_base_length
leg_base_length.rationale: The user's overall length of 120 mm along local X. The base leg runs x = 0..120.

leg_upright_height.name: leg_upright_height
leg_upright_height.rationale: The user's support height of 65 mm along local Z, measured from the base bottom face z = 0.

bracket_width.name: bracket_width
bracket_width.rationale: The user's overall width of 70 mm along local Y, symmetric about y = 0.

bracket_thickness.name: bracket_thickness
bracket_thickness.rationale: The user's base thickness of 12 mm. This is well above the 2 mm minimum wall in DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN.

upright_thickness.name: upright_thickness
upright_thickness.rationale: The user's vertical support thickness of 10 mm. It is given explicitly because it differs from the 12 mm base thickness.

bend_inner_radius.name: bend_inner_radius
bend_inner_radius.rationale: The user minimum of R5. It meets the >= 3 mm end-mill rule and the fatigue ratio 5/12 = 0.42 >= 0.2. The generator sets the outer fillet to 5 + 12 = 17 mm.

base_hole_diameter.name: base_hole_diameter
base_hole_diameter.rationale: The user's Ø10 finished hole. It is kept as given, although it is the ISO 273 coarse clearance for M8, not the medium value of 9.0 (advisory STD-ISO273-MEDIUM).

base_hole_rows.name: base_hole_rows
base_hole_rows.rationale: The two base holes are set as one row across the width (1 x 2 = 2 holes, R10).

base_hole_cols.name: base_hole_cols
base_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y = 0 give the 2 holes of R10 and a lateral bolt spread against roll moments.

base_hole_x0.name: base_hole_x0
base_hole_x0.rationale: The row sits on the free part of the base, well clear of the bend fillet end at x = 15 (gap of 55 mm to the hole edge leaves room for the bolt head and tool). The distance to the free end x = 120 is 45 mm >= 15 mm (1.5 d).

base_hole_pitch_x.name: base_hole_pitch_x
base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Ignored by the generator because there is only 1 row. Placeholder value only.

base_hole_pitch_y.name: base_hole_pitch_y
base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Holes at y = +/-18. Side edge distance is 35 - 18 = 17 mm >= 15 mm (1.5 x 10).

upright_hole_diameter.name: upright_hole_diameter
upright_hole_diameter.rationale: The user's Ø8 finished hole. It is kept as given, although it is a large clearance for M6 and not an ISO 273 medium value (advisory STD-ISO273-MEDIUM).

upright_hole_rows.name: upright_hole_rows
upright_hole_rows.rationale: One row across the width gives 1 x 2 = 2 holes (R11).

upright_hole_cols.name: upright_hole_cols
upright_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y = 0 for the front-wing interface.

upright_hole_z0.name: upright_hole_z0
upright_hole_z0.rationale: The distance to the top edge z = 65 is 20 mm >= 12 mm (1.5 x 8). The hole is 28 mm above the inner fillet end at z = 17, which leaves bolt-head and tool access.

upright_hole_pitch_z.name: upright_hole_pitch_z
upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Ignored by the generator because there is only 1 row. Placeholder value only.

upright_hole_pitch_y.name: upright_hole_pitch_y
upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Holes at y = +/-18, matching the base pattern. Side edge distance is 17 mm >= 12 mm (1.5 x 8).

requirements.text: The part is a rigid mounting bracket representing the structural connection of the front wing to the vehicle. It must be parametric and manufacturable.
requirements.quote: Ön kanadın araç üzerindeki yapısal bağlantısını temsil eden, parametrik ve üretilebilir bir mounting bracket oluşturmak.

requirements.text: The part is an F1-inspired engineering demonstrator. It must not be presented as a real FIA-homologated part.
requirements.quote: Gerçek FIA homologasyon parçası olduğunu iddia etme.

requirements.text: Dimensions and geometric rules are to be treated as engineering assumptions defined within the project scope.
requirements.quote: Boyutları ve geometrik kuralları proje kapsamında tanımlanmış mühendislik varsayımları olarak kabul et.

requirements.text: The bracket must have two main connection zones.
Overall bracket length (local X, longitudinal) is 120 mm.
Overall bracket width (local Y, lateral) is 70 mm.
Base leg thickness is 12 mm.
Vertical support (upright) thickness is 10 mm.
Support height (local Z) is 65 mm.
The base leg has 2 mounting holes of diameter 10 mm (vehicle-side connection).
The upright has 2 front-wing mounting holes of diameter 8 mm.
The minimum fillet radius is 5 mm.
The geometry must be non-symmetric, with a clearly identifiable orientation.
requirements.quote: simetrik olmayan / yönü belli bir geometri

requirements.text: Local X is the part's longitudinal direction.
Local Y is the part's lateral direction.
Local Z is the vertical direction.
Keep the existing generator origin as the part origin for now.
requirements.quote: Origin için şimdilik mevcut generator origin'ini koru.

requirements.text: Placement position X is 500 mm.
Placement position Y is -250 mm.
Placement position Z is 150 mm.
Placement roll is 15 deg.
Placement pitch is 35 deg.
Placement yaw is 60 deg.
The part must be designed so it can later be assembled with other F1 parts, with a meaningful coordinate frame inside the Fusion assembly.
requirements.quote: daha sonra başka F1 parçalarıyla assembly oluşturulabilecek şekilde tasarlanmış olması

assumptions.text: Scope: concept-level demonstrator with nominal geometry only. No FEA, no tolerancing, no FIA compliance, structural-safety or race-readiness claim.
assumptions.rationale: Stated by the user (R02, R03) and by project policy.
assumptions.impact: All results are indicative, for demonstration and assembly-framework purposes.

assumptions.text: Material is assumed to be a machinable high-strength aluminium alloy (7075-T6 class) until the user specifies otherwise.
assumptions.rationale: A common choice for machined motorsport brackets. The user did not specify a material.
assumptions.impact: Affects only mass properties and any later strength check, not the geometry.

assumptions.text: The part is assumed to be machined from billet (the only process the l_bracket generator supports).
assumptions.rationale: The user asked for a manufacturable part without naming a process.
assumptions.impact: Internal corners use fillets of at least the R12 minimum. No draft or casting features.

assumptions.text: No load case is defined. Load-dependent structural checks are reported as NOT_RUN, not as passed.
assumptions.rationale: The user gave no load, and loads must not be invented.
assumptions.impact: Strength and stiffness of the bracket are unverified until the user supplies a load case.

assumptions.text: The Ø10 and Ø8 values are treated as finished hole diameters. Bolt thread, grade and clearance class are not specified.
assumptions.rationale: The user specified holes, not fasteners (R10, R11).
assumptions.impact: Fastener selection and hole fit must be confirmed before interfacing with real parts.

assumptions.text: Hole positions, spacing and edge distances follow the l_bracket generator's parametric defaults. Each pair is placed in its own leg, and the values are exposed as named parameters.
assumptions.rationale: Not given by the user. R03 allows project-defined geometric assumptions.
assumptions.impact: Mating F1 parts must later adopt or re-parameterise these interface positions.

assumptions.text: Base holes (R10) form the vehicle/chassis-side connection zone. Upright holes (R11) form the front-wing connection zone. Together they satisfy the two connection zones of R04.
assumptions.rationale: Follows from the hole labels in the request.
assumptions.impact: Defines which leg faces which mating part in later assemblies.

assumptions.text: The L-profile (a base leg with an upright at one end) provides the required directional asymmetry along local X.
assumptions.rationale: R13 asks for an orientation-defined geometry. The l_bracket form is inherently asymmetric along its longitudinal axis.
assumptions.impact: No additional asymmetric features are added unless requested.

assumptions.text: Roll, pitch and yaw are applied about X, Y and Z respectively, using the project's standard pose convention (VCS: +X front, +Y left, +Z up). The position is the placement of the generator origin.
assumptions.rationale: The user did not state a rotation order. The project convention is used for consistency with other parts.
assumptions.impact: A different rotation order would yield a different final orientation.

assumptions.text: Fastener designations: M8 for the Ø10 base holes and M6 for the Ø8 upright holes. The user's hole diameters are kept as the finished diameters.
assumptions.rationale: The generator requires a fastener string (the previous plan failed with base_fastener/upright_fastener = None). Ø10 is the ISO 273 coarse clearance for M8. Ø8 is the nearest usable clearance for M6. The user specified holes, not bolts (A05).
assumptions.impact: STD-ISO273-MEDIUM will flag an advisory mismatch. The bolt size and fit must be confirmed by the user before mating with real parts.

assumptions.text: The load case is entered as force 0 N and lever arm 0 mm with a placeholder safety factor of 1.0. This only signals 'no load defined'.
assumptions.rationale: The schema requires a load case, but no load was given and loads must not be invented (A04).
assumptions.impact: The structural check is NOT_RUN. Strength is unverified until the user supplies a load.
